name: sema
description: Use Sema before creating or editing software: ask about first-time adoption, confirm context, and follow local contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Contract workflow before creating or editing
interface.longDescription: Loads Sema for software creation and editing, including static apps. Asks about first-time adoption, confirms the configured context window, then delegates to the local AGENTS.md protocol. Installation and repair remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Initialize Sema in this project and prepare its AGENTS.md protocol for Codex
Install or locate the Sema CLI and bootstrap this workspace
Repair a missing Sema AGENTS.md handshake in this project
